rules.trigger: Inventor source false affirmatives whose exact country has independently documented residential diplomatic, military/research, employment or study postings.
rules.action: Versioned exclusion of affirmative and paired negation, with positive evidence attached; no relabeling or partition moves.
rules.targeted_revalidation: Across outer train/D/E, enumerate retained inventor false affirmatives and inspect institutional full biographies for foreign postings/residences. Normalize only approved country spellings, resolve person identity, and manually adjudicate exact claim. No arbitrary travel-duration cutoff, and no country-set nonmembership inference. Preserve original sample outcomes and distinguish newly discovered cases.

rules.trigger: Unresolved exact residence claims, slash-separated country subjects, historical/current border ambiguity, or joint-person subjects lacking evidence for every named person.
rules.action: Propose paired quarantine of unresolved sample rows; create a separately versioned targeted queue for analogous rows across all outer partitions. Do not apply automatic new truth labels.
rules.targeted_revalidation: Inventory all retained inventor slash/joint-person rows and historically time-dependent location claims using source facts only. Freeze any new residence/geography/subject interpretation before adjudicating that targeted population; preserve which interpretations change each judgment.

rules.trigger: The exact historical Franklin/France negative candidate.
rules.action: Preserve original rejected status and attach new positive residence evidence separately. Do not include it in sample error counts or invent paired original source IDs.
